title: NOV Time Business Support Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
 The role is accountable for onboarding and supporting the functional tasks required from the system user groups, such as Managers, Employees, Powers Users \& HR to ensure the system is being used correctly and consistently. This will involve creation, update and assignment of training, onboarding materials, communications and user management auditing, to ensure end users are performing their tasks in adherence with policy and procedure.
   

  

 The NOV Time Business Support Analyst will conduct monthly audit activities to ensure timekeeping entries are as required, providing local follow up actions as necessary to address missing items or incorrect utilization as identified. A continuous improvement approach will ensure audit outcomes drive future actions regarding training and communications to mitigate identified issues.
   

  

 The role will work closely with the NOV Time Configuration Team members keeping up to date with systems configuration rules, functional upgrades, new country roll outs and change management, so these can be integrated into the functional end user support activities that the Business Support Analyst provides.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Support timekeeping period closure user activities, such as missing approvals and exceptions clear\-outs, against the monthly country payroll calendar.
* Escalate any technical issues observed to the applicable application support teams.
* Performing monthly operational audits of the global timekeeping system, for data integrity and user policy compliance criteria as part of a quality control routine.
* Following up with local HR \& Power Users where audit results and focus areas are identified for monitoring and review, with a view to improving end user compliance.
* Preparing monthly reports \& dashboards on the quality control status for HR Management.
* Maintain and deliver to the timekeeping user groups, the applicable end user training materials, ensuring all users have been onboarded and orienteered in system usage through developing global communications and performing monthly onboarding routines for the various user groups.
* Perform virtual training sessions for HR, Power Users and other business user groups to ensure effective adoption of the system.
* Maintain the global Power User group log for business coverage and change updates.
* Work with the Timekeeping Technical Team as well as HR \& Payroll groups, with the development of the end user training materials to ensure systems utilization is efficient and compliant, with an emphasis on continuous improvement and feedback loops from the operational audits.
* Perform and document external and internal audit controls around end\-user maintenance, liaising with local HR stakeholders as required.


**Qualifications**
* Relevant degree in Human Resources, Information Systems, Business Administration or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* 2\-5 years of experience supporting HRIS, Payroll or Time \& Attendance systems.
* Experience supporting global or multi\-country HR or payroll processes is preferred.

 The estate is split across non\-production and production environments and includes the Central Administration Site (CAS), Primary Sites and their SQL site databases, which are the true single point of failure for a site. * Apply Microsoft SCCM/APPPROXY hotfixes and SQL Server cumulative updates (CU/GDR) as prerequisites for a healthy SCCM/APPPROXY platform, coordinating carefully around SQL site databases to avoid taking a whole site down.
* Support High\-Availability failover patching (patch passive node/SQL replica, switch active/passive, patch former active) to minimize outage windows.


**Vulnerability Management \& Remediation**
* Own the remediation of vulnerabilities flagged against the SCCM/APPPROXY server estate (e.g. GVM / scanner findings from tools such as Qualys / Tenable), tracking each item to closure within SLA.
* Triage and prioritize findings by criticality (CVSS), separating in\-scope SCCM/APPPROXY/SQL items from those owned by other teams and re\-assigning out\-of\-scope items correctly (accurate CMDB ownership).
* Validate that deployed fixes actually mitigate the reported vulnerability, remove flagged/unnecessary software, and capture evidence for audit and closure.
* Maintain and report remediation status, backlog reduction and platform health metrics to the SCCM/APPPROXY lead and stakeholders.
